project_title: Looking for a Full stack developer Python, FAST API to enhance an existing agent on our platform
question: For the historical requirements relevant to the current client task, reconstruct their last valid state immediately before the current task. Do not apply the current task to that state.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: No—everything needs to be in 1 milestone, the whole list, and the second milestone is Shopline. You just split it into 4, and the price is around 850$; the rest of the budget is allocated for Shopline.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I’ve gone through both the agent requirements and the shared SHOPLINE documents.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: To clarify, I’m referring to the agents available on the website.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: After signing up, I accessed and inspected the agents.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Within the Lumen Concierge, I found the Query Agent, Styling Agent, Trend Curation Agent, Voting Agent, and Proxy Voting Agent.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My understanding now is that the main objective is to improve the agents already in place.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Good—what timeline would you need to complete the work?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The current system should be extended with mood boards, improved retrieval, usage tracking, credits, and Stripe plans, with particular attention given to the Styling Agent.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Bear in mind that we use Veyra AI, not OPEN AI SOL 8.2. I have free credits from its founder, and its reasoning is surprisingly good; we even replaced tavily api and <http://exa.ai|exa.ai> with it for retrieval from the web. Its image creation is also good, as you can see on the AI blog, so it should work well for the mood board, which is not rocket science. I’m unsure about selfie-created styling, though, so you need to test the prompt through the backend and send me the results.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Understood

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: If Veyra AI is already working well for reasoning, retrieval, and image generation, I’ll retain that flow rather than add OpenAI. I also agree that implementing the mood board should be straightforward.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The main pieces will be a well-structured backend prompt, a clean response format, and integration with the UI.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No, no—the issue is that Oprn AI is far too expensive for us.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Understood; we can leave OpenAI out of this implementation.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: To demonstrate what I want from the mood board, I could record a video in which I prompt open AI.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For the actual implementation, we avoid open ai everywhere, hahah.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: If Veyra AI is already producing strong reasoning, retrieval, and image results, optimizing the existing setup is the sensible approach. For both the mood board and selfie styling, I’ll retain the current Veyra AI configuration and test the backend prompts, proposing an alternative only if a genuine quality or cost problem appears.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, clear

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Then OpenAI is officially banned from the kitchen 😄

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The implementation will stay centered on Veyra AI, with our work limited to improving the prompts, backend flow, and results.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That would be perfect, yes.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I don’t think you’ve provided a timeline yet.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My preliminary estimate is 8 to 12 working days, although I can make it more accurate once I’ve reviewed the codebase.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before I provide a clear estimate for the final version and its completion time, please give me four days to review the codebase and audit the current agent structure.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: And what about the Shopline Widget?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: As a separate milestone, I would handle the SHOPLINE widget. Before estimating it, I need to examine the current backend and the SHOPLINE API requirements—especially OAuth, product APIs, content publishing, and compliance webhooks. A reliable estimate can come only afterward, since this part depends heavily on the codebase and SHOPLINE review requirements.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’ll lay out the full plan; tell me whether you agree with it.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here is how we could organize the milestones:

1\. Begin with a 4 days codebase audit covering the agents, Veyra AI integration, Supabase, user flow, and backend structure. Once that is complete, the Styling Agent and mood board feature become the first main milestone.

2\. Next, run the selfie-styling tests through the backend and send you the results. We can decide whether to build the complete feature only after reviewing them.

3\. Because they are connected, combine usage tracking, credits, and Stripe subscriptions into one milestone.

4\. Treat analytics and minor website fixes as smaller tasks.

5\. Keep Shopline as a separate milestone, since it requires OAuth, product APIs, content/blog APIs, webhooks, and review compliance.

More accurate timing for each milestone can be provided after the audit.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’d begin with a codebase audit lasting 4 days, covering the agents, Veyra AI integration, Supabase, user flow, and backend structure. After the audit, please indicate how you want the milestones divided according to your business priorities so I can estimate each one properly.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I’ll grant you access to DO and Supabase. Even if Shopline is separated into its own milestone, it still belongs to the same budget. Have you developed for Shopline before? They offer a developer account, although I honestly haven’t explored it much. The best part is that it can fetch everything from our existing platform.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks, understood. Because most of the content already comes from Lumen, the implementation should be much easier. During the audit, I’ll examine the Shopline developer account and determine the cleanest implementation approach.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For an individual client, I previously completed a Shopline integration, so I know the general flow. Because every app setup can differ, I’ll still inspect your shopline developer account and verify the exact API requirements.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What structure would you prefer for our first contract?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: One option is to begin with a small audit contract and define the later milestones once it is complete, though you’re welcome to suggest whichever structure works best for you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: My suggestion is 850$ for everything except Shopline, followed by Shopline afterward. How long would developing Shopline take? Another important point is that the Veyra AI API counts only the tokens consumed through the API. Before integrating Stripe, we must measure token usage for each specific prompt and use those figures to create the monetization tiers. Are you familiar with that process?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That is something I’m familiar with, yes.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The usage-tracking layer should be built first, with Stripe integration coming afterward. For every Veyra AI call, Supabase will store the user, agent, prompt type, token usage, and estimated cost. That data will let us calculate average usage for each prompt type and base the subscription tiers on real measurements rather than guesses.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: An estimate for shopline has to wait until I’ve reviewed the developer account and exact API flow. For the $850 scope, we should first define precisely what is included; once that is settled, I’ll begin with the audit and prioritize the usage board.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before I estimate the individual parts, could you send me your complete plan and preferred way of dividing the work?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Once you provide that, I’ll clearly estimate every part, including shopline. We can then open the first contract with the first milestone.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: To begin the work, please provide the required access: the GitHub repo, DO, Supabase, and the shopline developer account.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Apart from the Shopline widget, everything described in the job post is included.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I believe the chat and the posted offer already cover the full scope, including the small front-end text edits described in the offer.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
We can start with $1,200 for the current scope, excluding the shopline widget for now.

Milestone 1: Codebase audit + technical plan and Styling Agent mood board
Review the agents, Veyra AI flow, Supabase, backend structure, and deployment.
Implement the first mood board flow using Veyra AI and connect it with the existing agent.

Milestone 2: Veyra AI usage tracking
Track token usage per prompt/agent in Supabase, so we can define the monetization tiers before Stripe.

Milestone 3: Selfie styling test
Prompt Veyra AI from the backend, generate test results, and send them for review.

Milestone 4: Analytics & small website fixes
Handle the smaller tracking and UI/text improvements.

After this, we can create a separate milestone for the shopline widget once I review the shopline dev account and API flow.
